description.value: Salt Spring Wild Cider is a craft cidery and farm restaurant producing artisanal ciders from heritage apple and pear trees — some over 100 years old — harvested from properties across Salt Spring Island, drawing on the island's history as once the largest apple producer in BC. Visitors can taste, share a bottle, or sit down for a full lunch or dinner in a rustic farm setting with both indoor seating and outdoor picnic tables. The cidery is open year-round, seven days a week, and welcomes families and dogs in the outdoor area.
